subject.title: Proposal: model-callable `clear_goal` tool with bounded canonical-store archive

question: Should OpenClaw allow models to clear terminal or paused session goals through a new `clear_goal` tool, and if so which states and retention contract should be supported?
rationale: The current source and docs intentionally reserve clearing, pausing, resuming, and replacing goals for operator/session controls, so adding model-callable clearing changes product authority rather than fixing a broken contract.

options.title: Keep operator-only clearing
options.body: Preserve the current documented boundary where models can complete or block goals, and users clear them with `/goal clear` or reset controls.

options.title: Approve terminal-only clear_goal
options.body: Add a model-callable clear tool for a maintainer-approved non-active state set, with bounded canonical session-store archive semantics.

options.title: Approve complete/blocked only
options.body: Allow clearing only after model-reachable `complete` or `blocked` states while leaving paused and limit states operator-controlled.

recommendation.title: Keep operator-only clearing
recommendation.body: Preserve the current documented boundary where models can complete or block goals, and users clear them with `/goal clear` or reset controls.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the current core session-goals contract and are the strongest history-backed owner for deciding whether that model authority boundary should change.
